userStories.name: Align MCP operator docs with live bridge contract
userStories.description: Update the MCP operator documentation so AI-client setup instructions match the current prompts, resources, and stdio HTTP-bridge behavior implemented in pkg/mcp and cmd/weave-mcp.
bdd_acceptance: Given the MCP server advertises prompts and resources capabilities, When an operator reads docs/mcp.md, Then the methods table describes prompts/list, prompts/get, resources/list, and resources/read as live surfaces rather than stubs.

Given cmd/weave-mcp now bridges stdio clients to a running /mcp endpoint when WEAVE_MCP_URL is set, When an operator reads the transport and limitations sections, Then the docs explain bridge mode and no longer describe the binary as only a stub.

Given resources/list includes ontology, objecttype, and temporary ObjectSet resources, When an operator follows docs/mcp.md, Then the resource URI table includes weave://objecttype/<ontology>/<objectType> and explains the object type schema payload.

userStories.name: Correct GeoTemporal PG-store documentation drift
userStories.description: Correct stale GeoTemporal docs and package comments that still claim only in-memory storage exists even though PgStore, server PG default wiring, and spatial-temporal query support are implemented.
bdd_acceptance: Given pkg/geotemporal/pg_store.go and cmd/server/main.go wire a PG-backed GeoTemporal store when PG is available, When a developer reads package comments and operator docs, Then they describe PG as the durable default and memory as degraded mode.

Given GeoTemporal supports spatial-temporal bbox and time range queries through Store capability checks, When a developer reads the docs, Then the query capability and relevant tests/migrations are referenced accurately.
Given older OSv2 status docs mention GeoTemporal as memory-only, When the documentation contract runs, Then those stale claims fail until corrected.
